title: Carry a second host's item evidence (work notes, gates, checkpoints) to the home store where acceptance evaluation and landing run
outcome: Carry a second host's item evidence (work notes, gates, checkpoints) to the home store where acceptance evaluation and landing run
acceptance: A coder on a second host (Windows B) working an item under a local claim can make that item's generic work notes and status checkpoints reach the home store (Central) through the engram-data exchange, with original ids and origin-machine provenance, while live claims, delivery state and private scratch still never transfer

The design states whether this is the existing notes profile (git-task-sync.md: opt-in generic and status note families, an explicit coordinated re-baseline per :1029-1030, the same profile on every exporting host) or the designed evidence packs (:1493, not yet shipped), names who runs the switch and in what order across Central, Windows B and DL560, and is reviewed before coding

Gate, host-verification and evaluation records keep their current rule: they are produced where the registered run or evaluation happens and are not note-export candidates; the doc says plainly which evidence a second host's work can and cannot contribute to a home-store evaluation
